verdict.rationale: Supabase ships an official MCP server letting AI assistants query/operate projects via natural language, confirmed live in a hands-on probe, and CLI/init flows can be driven headlessly by agents. However, community reports document real security caveats — prompt-injection vulnerabilities requiring mitigations, and MCP-driven agents operating via service_role which bypasses RLS — indicating the NL-agent interface is real but not yet fully safe/mature.
